doc: SELFAUDIT-1: the probed failure-mode register the tick Worker runs itself every tick (worker/src/selfaudit.js). Each probe is one read-only SELECT returning 1 when healthy. A red probe files or reopens item FM-<id> (owner role, closing probe selfaudit:<id>); the item may only close when its probe is green, never by a message. Detection, owner, trigger and remedy are data here; nothing waits on a person.

modes.failure: Items are dispatched again and again and never produce an outcome (the claim lapses, the reaper releases it, the tick re-dispatches it).
modes.root_cause: No consumer closes a dispatch: dispatches stay 'queued' and the re-dispatch had no loop-breaker.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM (SELECT item_id FROM dispatches WHERE at >= datetime('now','-3 days') GROUP BY item_id HAVING COUNT(*)>=3 AND item_id IS NOT NULL AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT item_id FROM outcomes WHERE item_id IS NOT NULL) AND item_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM items WHERE status IN ('blocked','done','superseded','cancelled')))
modes.remedy: tick dispatch step blocks an item after max_redispatch dispatches without an outcome and files LOOPBREAK-<item> (guiding directive 2)

modes.failure: k_eff counts zero deploys because no independent deploy evidence reaches D1.
modes.root_cause: Q-CRIT-COLLECTORS was filed and never built, so criticality_samples and verified deploy outcomes stay empty.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM outcomes WHERE action_class='deploy' AND result='verified' AND evidence LIKE 'probe:%' AND at >= datetime('now','-14 days')
modes.remedy: ingestDeploys reads ops/deploys.jsonl (live_matches_commit rows, written by the post-deploy verifier) into outcomes each tick

modes.failure: k_eff is below k_min: loops cost more than they yield.
modes.root_cause: Numerator starved (no deploy evidence) and denominator inflated by phantom re-dispatches.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT json_extract(value,'$.k_eff') FROM org WHERE key='criticality'),0) >= 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: raise verified deploys or cut dispatch waste; the criticality step keeps an ORIGIN item at the head until it holds

fixes.title: Raise k_eff numerator: make every worker deploy append a verified live_matches_commit row to ops/deploys.jsonl so ingestDeploys credits it.
Raise k_eff by cutting the denominator: find the roles whose dispatches end with no outcome and shrink or split their items.

modes.failure: The tick has not finished a run in the last 30 minutes.
modes.root_cause: cron not firing or the Worker failing before the tick row finishes.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)>0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM tick_runs WHERE finished_at IS NOT NULL AND started_at >= datetime('now','-30 minutes')
modes.remedy: second route: executor workflow and GitHub Actions dispatch (EXEC-SPARK-1)

modes.failure: The server-side sweeper last pass was not ok, or has not run for 2 hours.
modes.root_cause: GitHub App token missing or registered on the wrong account (REPO-ACCESS-1).
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT status='ok' AND at >= datetime('now','-2 hours') FROM sweeper_runs ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1),0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: adopt the right installation by code, register the App under the org; consent screen is the single identity-bound step

modes.failure: An open gate card has no default in effect, so an owner-only step stalls work.
modes.root_cause: an identity-bound step with no staged default in effect.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM gate_cards WHERE status='open' AND (default_in_effect IS NULL OR default_in_effect='')
modes.remedy: stage the default and let the loop proceed on it

modes.failure: An item left the active set with no disposition.
modes.root_cause: a path that sets done without a disposition.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM outcomes WHERE result='silent_drop' AND at >= datetime('now','-1 day')
modes.remedy: reconcile reopens the item; fix the writer

modes.failure: The GitHub App does not cover the ultrastable org repositories, so sweeper, lane and deploy evidence cannot run.
modes.root_cause: The App was registered on the personal account; only the org owner's GitHub passkey can finish registration on the org (identity-bound).
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE((SELECT json_extract(value,'$.ok') FROM org WHERE key='repo_access'),0)=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: keep gate card GATE-REPO-ACCESS open with its default in effect and the consent screen (/connect/github) served; checkRepoAccess re-probes every tick and adopts the installation by code once it exists. Never ask for a token.

modes.failure: Items the doer parked as needs-code sit in the backlog with nothing building them.
modes.root_cause: The in-tick doer can only edit the backlog database, and no executor read the items it parked: 66 needs-code items waited while the code executor reported idle (2026-11-15). Spec and roadmap items were never built unless a person prompted for them.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM items WHERE status='blocked' AND blocker LIKE 'needs-code:%' AND updated_at < datetime('now','-24 hours')
modes.remedy: every needs-code item is taken by the executor (nativeexec runDbQueue) within a day; if the executor has no GitHub credential, the credential route is the next fix, never a person's prompt.

fixes.title: Give the executor a second route that does not need the Worker's GitHub credential, so needs-code items are built on every deployment
fixes.done_check: an item blocked needs-code is marked in-pr within 24 h of parking on a deployment with no GitHub App credential

modes.failure: The code executor ticks and reports idle or failed while needs-code items wait.
modes.root_cause: The executor read one repo queue file; the backlog database was not a source, so a full queue looked like idle (2026-11-15). Also idle when the Worker holds no GitHub credential.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE status='blocked' AND blocker LIKE 'needs-code:%')=0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM loop_beats WHERE loop='executor' AND started_at >= datetime('now','-24 hours') AND detail LIKE '%opened %') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: the executor opens a pull request for a needs-code item at least once a day while any waits; a day of idle beats with a queue is a defect with a fix item, not a quiet state.

fixes.title: Read the executor beat detail, name why it opened no pull request (credential, model refusal, guard) and fix that cause in code
fixes.done_check: the executor opens a pull request for a needs-code item

modes.failure: A dispatch record or the operations page names a configured tier label instead of the model that ran.
modes.root_cause: roles.model is a bootstrap tier alias (claude-haiku-5-5, small); the tick copied it into every dispatch row and /ops showed it as the model, while no Claude model was ever called (2026-11-15).
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*)=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM dispatches WHERE model IN ('claude-haiku-5-5','claude-sonnet-5-5','claude-opus-5-5','small','medium','large')
modes.remedy: the doer writes the model that answered, or 'rules (no model)', when it settles an item; /ops reads dispatch rows only.

fixes.title: Find the writer of a tier label into dispatches.model and make it record the real model
fixes.done_check: no dispatch row carries a tier label

modes.failure: A tick has been standby or demoted for a day, so no loop runs in its account.
modes.root_cause: Two deployments (two Cloudflare accounts) were moved by hand; nothing guaranteed exactly one primary (2026-11-15). The controller (cutover.js) now records slot and epoch every beat.
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cutover_state WHERE k='slot' AND v<>'primary' AND at < datetime('now','-24 hours')) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
modes.remedy: a demoted tick resumes after three beats without a primary peer (cutover.js RESUME_BEATS); a standby promotes itself when it holds a GitHub credential.

fixes.title: Resume as primary at an epoch above the last seen when the peer is absent, and record why
fixes.done_check: cutover_state slot is primary, or the peer account is verifiably primary and this account is intentionally standby

modes.failure: Ready or open items wait for hours while the dispatch loop settles nothing.
modes.root_cause: A cost breach on a database the tick never reads (the analytics DB ultrastable-ops, 52.5k vs 50k rows/h, 2026-11-17) held the tick lean for the hour, so dispatch and execute were skipped, claims were released unworked and issues stayed open (OPS-QUEUE-1).
modes.probe: SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM items WHERE status IN ('ready','open') AND priority > 0 AND created_at < datetime('now','-6 hours'))=0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dispatches WHERE status IN ('done','parked') AND at >= datetime('now','-6 hours')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
modes.remedy: while a takeable item is older than 6 hours, at least one dispatch settles (done or parked) every 6 hours; a window with none is a defect with a fix item, and only a breach of a database the tick reads (gates_tick) may hold dispatch.

fixes.title: Find why no dispatch settled in 6 hours (lean mode, released claims, doer errors) and fix the cause
fixes.done_check: a dispatch settled done or parked within the last 6 hours
